description_en: Exports the full list of knowledge produced by an inventory task as an XLSX file
description_zh: 全量导出盘点任务产出的知识列表为 XLSX 文件
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise export-inventory-knowledge --job-id 1001 --query '订单' --show-type TABLE --sort-by confidence --sort-order desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExportInventoryKnowledge

parameters.help_en: The ID of the inventory task
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The search keyword used for fuzzy matching of knowledge content
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，用于模糊匹配知识内容
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The knowledge display type filter, such as TABLE, COLUMN, SQL, SEG, LINEAGE, or TERM
parameters.help_zh: 知识展示类型筛选，如 TABLE、COLUMN、SQL、SEG、LINEAGE、TERM 等
parameters.name: show_type

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

confidence
entityId

Default value: confidence
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order.

Default value: desc
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向，可选值：asc（正序）、desc（倒序），默认desc
parameters.name: sort_order
